WONDERFUL FAMILY DINING EXPERIENCE
Dec 2025 • Family
Took my Vietnamese family to El Gaucho, Phu My Hung, HCMC, VN (Saturday night) - party of six, four adults and two children - main reason for attending, child birthday treat and both the adults and children enjoyed the whole evening - FANTASTIC NIGHT - The food was superb, the staff were so friendly, courteous and most helpful - a delightful ambience / atmosphere and for us, the location is perfect. We booked in advance and the service was excellent, everything flowing as it should - we were also very comfortably seated. Couldn't have expected or asked for more. Among other items chosen, we had a tomahawk steak and it was cooked to perfection. As to price; for that quality, it was spot on, no complaints at all. Our thanks to the Manager, Mr. Marquez and all the staff and in particular to Ms. Nguyen Ly To Trinh and “Sarah,” our waitress, who was so lovely. And as MacArthur said “we” will return!

Amazing steak.
Aug 2024 • Couples
El Gaucho is THE place to eat if you want to experience perfect steak.
It’s all about the meat here, no unnecessary extras. Just perfectly cooked steak.
I chose the New York Strip with side of fries and thick pepper sauce. Cooked to perfection. (Medium plus) and my wife had sirloin.
Toffee vodka shot (complimentary) was a nice way to end meal.
Not the cheapest of places to eat but certainly worth it for a special ‘treat’ and it restored our faith in finding the perfect steak. Probably the best steak I’ve eaten anywhere!
You have to pay for quality sometimes.
